case.pattern_description: Although the transaction occurred from a new device, investigation of a similar closed case confirmed the device profile represents a generic OS and browser fingerprint shared by numerous cards rather than a fraud ring.
case.summary: Case HHG-005 for $100.07 was automatically closed as legitimate after reviewing transaction details, timelines, and device profiles with no matching past cases. Although the device profile was shared by 223 other cards, it was determined to be a generic browser fingerprint rather than a sign of a fraud ring. Because no suspicious patterns were found and the calculated fraud probability of 0.05 fell well below the 0.15 stopping threshold, the initial and final recommendation remained to close the case with no fraud detected.
